surface.purpose: Standing surfaces: menus, pills, mode-switch thumb, knobs.

white.purpose: Bench pill and baseline time toggle only (formerly --corridor; the corridor is removed).

hair.purpose: Column hairlines, section rules, chart verticals.

ink.purpose: Text, ruler, band numerals, library-strip dots.

ink-2.purpose: Secondary text, attribute labels, polarity arrows, captions, placeholder rows.

series-a-violet.purpose: Series A; Sig-only on; focus, caret, selection; drop zone; Uploaded wash and New tag.

bench-line.purpose: Baseline series line and hollow markers only (dashed 5 4, 1.5px).

better-sage.purpose: Better: halos, list-head dot, verdict underline.

worse-clay.purpose: Worse: halos, list-head dot, verdict underline.

a-wash.purpose: Series A pill ground; Uploaded rows; drop-zone hover.

tint.purpose: The one hover / pressed ground; mode-switch and mini-segment track.

sentence.purpose: Italic connective words of the control sentence; 29px when tight.

verdict.purpose: Bodoni 21px / 1.45 caption to the chart; italic ink 2 as the prompt.

tally-numeral.purpose: n better · n worse · n on par, with 14px words.

findings-head.purpose: Better / Worse list heads, with an 18px halo swatch.

numeral.purpose: Upload counter; 46px in the model card; 19px ruler integers.

band-numeral.purpose: T0 / T3 / T6 at .13 opacity, right-aligned in the lower-right corner of each Comparison block, inside the plot.

body.purpose: Formula IDs in library rows; tooltips at 15.5px; tally IDs at 15px ink 2.

id.purpose: Formula ID inside a sentence pill.

caption.purpose: Chart caption, tool labels, counts, model-card text.

attribute.purpose: Uppercase attribute names in the chart (17px / 1.1px in Dynamic), ink 2, weight 400.

list-attribute.purpose: Findings list attribute, uppercase, ink 2; time 14px; signed difference 15px / 500.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Floating dropdown menus, with a 1px edge.

shadows.name: vellum-drop
shadows.purpose: Smoked-vellum glass; pair with backdrop-filter blur(14px) saturate(1.2) brightness(1.07) over rgba(47,41,61,.035).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one curve for every transition; JS uses the matching exponential ease-out.

motion.name: ink-drop
motion.purpose: A newly filled pill floods from its glyph.

breakpoints.name: stage
breakpoints.value: 1920 × 1050 fixed, scaled to fit; no reflow

chart.significance: Halos only; the tooltip states beyond / within the ±x threshold.

key.swatch: halo r 8.5 with ink dot r 3
key.comparison: on the T6 band numeral baseline, 22px left of it
key.dynamic: plot lower-right (x plotR - keyWidth - 6, y H - 16)

polarityInWords: strip tooltip: Higher / Lower is better

layout.findTop: verdict + tally + lists top-aligned; strips 28px below stretch row pitch 24–46px to fill the column; verdict no min-height; tally margin-top 24px

components.css: :host{--paper:#F5F3F7;--surface:#FCFBFD;--white:#FFFFFF;--edge:#E6E3EB;--hair:#DCD9E0;--ink:#2A2537;--ink-2:#6B5E82;--a:#625492;--b:#61829E;--better:#74936C;--worse:#B15D59;--a-wash:rgba(98,84,146,.10);--b-wash:rgba(97,130,158,.12);--tint:rgba(42,37,55,.045);--glass:rgba(47,41,61,.035);--glass-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.2) brightness(1.07);--glass-drop:0 10px 28px rgba(42,37,55,.13),0 1px 2px rgba(42,37,55,.06),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65);--lift:0 8px 22px rgba(42,37,55,.10),0 1px 2px rgba(42,37,55,.06);--serif:'Libre Bodoni',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Red Hat Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);} .ds-vellum{display:inline-block;min-width:260px;padding:14px 18px 15px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--glass);box-shadow:var(--glass-drop);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--glass-filter);backdrop-filter:var(--glass-filter);font-family:var(--sans);color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:lining-nums tabular-nums;transition:opacity .18s var(--ease),transform .18s var(--ease);} .ds-vellum:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);} .ds-tip-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;} .ds-caps{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.075em;font-weight:500;font-size:14.5px;} .ds-tip-time{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink-2);} .ds-tip-rows{display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px 1fr auto auto;column-gap:10px;row-gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:15.5px;} .ds-tip-rows b{font-weight:500;text-align:right;} .ds-d{color:var(--ink-2);text-align:right;min-width:3.2em;} .ds-tip-verdict{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(42,37,55,.12);font:400 18px var(--serif);} .ds-tip-verdict small{font:400 14.5px var(--sans);color:var(--ink-2);}

narrative.overview: A vertical sensory profile drawn straight on lilac paper against a dashed, hollow baseline: a point beyond its attribute's threshold gets a halo that says better or worse, and the tooltip states the threshold. The controls are one editorial sentence that is at once selector, chart title and legend. Structure comes from hairlines, surface contrast and whitespace; only floating things get a surface, and things that follow the pointer are smoked-vellum glass.
keyCharacteristics: Lilac paper, ink, one brand violet and one slate; sage / clay only as halos
Libre Bodoni 400 untracked for voice; Red Hat Text tabular for codes and data
Capsules for anything chosen, dashed borders for anything empty
Opaque standing surfaces, temporary vellum glass
One easing curve; lines flow rather than redraw

rules.name: The Halo Carries the Verdict Rule
rules.body: Sage and clay red never colour a line, a pill or text; they appear only as halos, the list-head dots and the verdict underline. The line keeps its series colour.

rules.name: The Uncoloured Baseline Rule
rules.body: The baseline is grey-violet, dashed and hollow; it never takes a series colour or the verdict pair.

rules.name: The Untracked Didone Rule
rules.body: Libre Bodoni is always `letter-spacing: 0`, with common and contextual ligatures on and proportional numerals.

rules.name: The Tabular Sans Rule
rules.body: Red Hat Text always runs lining tabular figures, so columns of readings align without a table.

rules.name: The Glass Is Temporary Rule
rules.body: Vellum only on what appears under the pointer and leaves; anything that stands on the page is opaque.

dos: **Do** keep every new colour inside the palette above; washes are the series colours at 10–12% and hover grounds are ink at 4.5%.
**Do** draw arrows, chevrons and marks as SVG strokes; both families ship Latin only.
**Do** use capsules for anything pressed or chosen and dashed borders for anything empty.
**Do** move with the one curve and the fast / state / flow durations.
**Do** give halos, not lines, the verdict colours, and spell *Better* / *Worse* out beside them.
donts: **Don't** track Libre Bodoni or set it in a weight other than 400.
**Don't** put a card behind a region; structure comes from hairlines, surface contrast and space.
**Don't** use vellum glass for anything that stays on the page, or an opaque surface for anything that follows the pointer.
**Don't** set text in uppercase except the eight attribute names.
**Don't** break the lines between time blocks (§16).
